findings.title: startup-and-session criterion numbering style
findings.problem: Cross-references label the revised startup-and-session criteria '14.12 / 14.40 / 14.46', but requirements.md numbers the same criteria as flat items '12.' and '46.' under their enclosing Requirement (14) and '20.3' under Requirement 20. The 14.NN label matches the sub-project's criterion-under-Requirement convention and introduces no ambiguity.
findings.fix: Optional: when implementing, keep the 14.NN labels consistent, or add a one-line note that criterion N in Requirement 14 is cited as 14.N. No change required for the gate.
